unaddressed_comments.body:
![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Instead of manually calling `Optional.ofNullable` and `s.trim()`, we can use the existing `ConfigurationUtil.getTrimmedValue` utility method. This is consistent with how other properties like `universe-domain` and `batch.threads` are parsed in this class, and it gracefully handles blank or empty values by falling back to the default instead of throwing an `IllegalArgumentException`.

```suggestion
    ConfigurationUtil.getTrimmedValue(analyticsCoreOptions, prefix + UPLOAD_TYPE_KEY)
        .map(s -> UploadType.valueOf(s.replace('-', '_').toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)))
        .ifPresent(optionsBuilder::setUploadType);
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Adhere to existing codebase patterns and use established utility classes (like ConfigurationUtil) to maintain consistency and avoid custom/redundant validation logic. <sup>([link](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/gcs-analytics-core/blob/main/.gemini/styleguide.md))</sup>
2. Avoid introducing individual parameter validations if it deviates from the existing codebase pattern. Maintain consistency with the existing parameter handling behavior.
</details>
